svg.aria-label: An English book and a Chinese book collide and merge into one bilingual book that alternates English and Chinese paragraphs.

g.text: 第一章 掉进兔子洞
Alice was beginning to get very tired of sitting by her sister on the bank,
and of having nothing to do.
爱丽丝陪姐姐坐在河岸上，无事可做，渐渐厌烦起来。
Once or twice she had peeped into the book her sister was reading,
but it had no pictures or conversations in it.
她偷偷瞄过一两眼姐姐在看的书，里面既没有图画，也没有对话。
“And what is the use of a book,” thought Alice,
“一本书要是没有图画，也没有对话，”爱丽丝想，“那还有什么意思呢？”
